# V5: header validity (Standard Profile 1)

Generated by gov5 from its own verification and execution code:
`go test -tags nosqlite,noboltdb ./internal -run TestProfile1VectorV5`
(`N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_UPDATE=1` rewrites these files; `N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_MIRROR=<dir>` also writes them to `<dir>/V5/`).
The test fails if a file differs from what gov5 computes, if a listed block is refused, or if a refusal is accepted.

## File

`header_validity.json`: a sealed six-block chain on V1's `genesis_8s.json` plus `allocAdditions` (the V3 test
sender, key = keccak256("n42-profile1-vectors-sender")), the genesis header, per block its header (fields, RLP, hash),
transactions (EIP-2718 bytes) and `executed` (its own result, carried by the next header), then the refusals.
Blocks are built as in V1 (extraData `N42H || view || CommitQC of the parent || seal`, leader(v) = v mod 4,
requestsHash = sha256("") 0xe3b0c442...b855 (AM24), element 22 = 0x80).

## gasUsed (A10, B13, EIP-8037)

Header N carries block N-1's `stateRoot`, `receiptsRoot`, `logsBloom` and `gasUsed` (k = 1). A block's gasUsed is
the EIP-8037 block figure

    gasUsed = max(sum of tx regular gas, sum of tx state gas)
    tx regular gas = max(gas used before refunds - tx state gas, calldata floor)

Refunds do not reduce it. It is NOT the receipts' cumulativeGasUsed (post-refund, state gas included), which is
unchanged. Same rule as alloy-evm 0.39 `eth/block.rs` (`max_block_gas_used`, "max(regular, state) gas without
refunds") and n42-rs.

| Block | Case | executed: regular / state / receipts -> gasUsed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `contract-create` | 48852 / 293760 / 332612 -> 293760 (state gas larger) |
| 2 | `sstore-clear-equal-timestamp` | 27380 / 0 / 21904 -> 27380 (refund ignored) |
| 3 | `new-account-transfer` | 21000 / 183600 / 204600 -> 183600 (state gas larger) |
| 4 | `plain-transfer` | 21000 / 0 / 21000 -> 21000 |
| 5 | `idle` | 0 -> 0 |
| 6 | `carries-idle` | 0 -> 0 |

Each header's `gasUsed` is its parent's row; B14's baseFee uses that field as written.

## B4: equal timestamps

Blocks 1 and 2 have the same timestamp (`parent.time == time` is valid, on import and at vote time). Both run the
EIP-4788 system call with that timestamp; block 2's write lands in the same ring-buffer index and is part of block
2's executed stateRoot, which block 3 carries.

## Refusals

Each refusal is a header of the chain rebuilt with one rule broken and resealed by its leader. `check`: `import` =
header verification on import; `vote` = only before the Round-1 vote at `nowUnix`; `deferred` = the deferred fields
against the parent's stored result (on import and in the vote gate). `expectedError` is gov5's sentinel where it has
one; `gov5Message` is its full message.

| Rule | Check | Case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B13 | deferred | block 2 carrying block 1's receipts' cumulative gas (332612) |
| B13 | deferred | block 3 carrying block 2's post-refund receipts gas (21904) |
| B13 | deferred | block 4 carrying block 3's regular + state gas (204600) |
| B13 | import | gasUsed = gasLimit + 1 (above the parent's gasLimit) |
| B4 | import | time = parent.time - 1 |
| B4 | vote | time > floor(now) + 2 |
| B9 | import | blobGasUsed = 1; excessBlobGas = 1 |
| B14 | import | baseFee derived from a parent gasUsed equal to the receipts' gas; baseFee + 1 |
| A23 | import | gasLimit != hotstuff.gasLimit |

V1 has the remaining header-profile rules (B1-B3, B6, B8, B12).
